items.title: Microsoft Drops Terrifyingly Large October Patch Update
items.description: October 2025's enormous Patch Tuesday offers plenty of nightmares for admins, including actively exploited zero-days and insidious high-severity privilege-escalation bugs — and it spells curtains for Windows 10 updates.

items.title: Malicious crypto-stealing VSCode extensions resurface on OpenVSX
items.description: A threat actor called TigerJack is constantly targeting developers with malicious extensions published on Microsoft's Visual Code (VSCode) marketplace and OpenVSX registry to steal cryptocurrency and plant backdoors. [...]

items.title: China's Flax Typhoon Turns Geo-Mapping Server into a Backdoor
items.description: Chinese APT threat actors compromised an organization's ArcGIS server, modifying the widely used geospatial mapping software for stealth access.

items.title: Pixnapping Attack Lets Attackers Steal 2FA on Android
items.description: The proof-of-concept exploit allows an attacker to steal sensitive data from Gmail, Google Accounts, Google Authenticator, Google Maps, Signal, and Venmo.

items.title: PolarEdge With Custom TLS Server Uses Custom Binary Protocol for C2 Communication
items.description: A sophisticated backdoor malware targeting Internet of Things devices has surfaced, employing advanced communication techniques to maintain persistent access to compromised systems. The PolarEdge backdoor, first detected in January 2025, represents a significant evolution in IoT-focused threats, utilizing a custom TLS server implementation and proprietary binary protocol for command and control…

items.title: New Cyberattack Leverages NPM Ecosystem to Infect Developers While Installing Packages
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have uncovered a sophisticated phishing campaign that weaponizes the NPM ecosystem through an unprecedented attack vector. Unlike traditional malicious package installations, this operation leverages the trusted unpkg.com CDN to deliver phishing scripts directly through browsers, targeting enterprise employees across 135+ organizations primarily in Europe’s industrial,…

items.title: Cybereason to be Acquired by MSSP Giant LevelBlue
items.description: This is LevelBlue’s third acquisition this year, after Trustwave and Aon’s Cybersecurity & IP Litigation Consulting groups. The post Cybereason to be Acquired by MSSP Giant LevelBlue appeared first on SecurityWeek.
